title: Measure
description: Output of `andon measure --json`: the flow, efficiency and counter metrics of one project's ledger over a period, derived from log.jsonl, issue.yaml, questions.yaml, report.json, gate records, corrections.json, GitHub's merged pull requests and the dispatcher's notification records (<slug>.recorded.jsonl and <slug>.delivered.jsonl), and the agents' session records (Claude Code and Codex) for token counts. Printed only; never written or kept. A count is 0 and a rate, mean or median is null when there is no record to count. Records that could not be read are listed in skipped, not counted as 0. Only these keys.

project.description: The project's slug (the folder that holds kanban/).

since.description: First day of the period, UTC, YYYY-MM-DD.

until.description: Last day of the period, included, UTC, YYYY-MM-DD.

value.description: Value (ADR-0011): did the value hypotheses of the Chief Engineer's documents come true. Derived from observation issues' report.json observation and the Chief Engineer issues; nothing new is written. An observation issue is a non-reviewer issue whose parent is the Chief Engineer issue (profile chief-engineer) it observes.

observed.description: Observation issues whose report (first move to review, else the last column) falls in the period, by report.json observation.result.

days_to_observe.description: From the Chief Engineer issue's last move to the last column to its observation issue's report, for the reports in the period: count and median days (two decimals; null when count is 0).

days.description: Median days, or null when count is 0.

no_hypothesis.description: Chief Engineer issues that moved to the last column in the period and have no observation issue (a non-reviewer child by parent whose report.json has an observation; an ordinary epic child does not count, even with a not_before), i.e. a hypothesis written as none.

flow.description: Flow: lead time, wait per state, questions open, throughput and WIP (Little's law).

lead_time.description: From the issue's creation to its pull request's merge, for pull requests merged in the period: count and median hours.

wait.description: Ledger status (every column but the last) -> issues that spent time in it during the period, and the mean hours each spent there. Reviewer issues are left out.

question_open.description: Questions open (asked, not yet answered) during the period: count and mean hours open within it.

closed.description: Issues moved to the last column in the period, and per day.

wip_end.description: Issues in progress (neither the first column, queued, nor the last) at the end of the period.

efficiency.description: Efficiency, per pull request merged in the period. Read next to counter.

merged_prs.description: Ledger pull requests (report.json pr) merged in the period.

human_touches.description: The owner's operations in the period by kind, and per merged pull request (the primary metric). Each is placed by its own time, so total can differ from the sum over prs[] (ADR-0049).

per_pr.description: total / merged_prs; null when none merged (total may still be above 0).

merge.description: Pull requests among merged_prs without a gate record with merged true: merged by the owner.

decision.description: Answers decided by the owner; equal to answers.owner.

task.description: Issues with who person and no question that moved from another column to the last in the period (done again on a done issue is not a move), once per issue.

answers.description: Answers in questions.yaml whose answered is in the period, by decidedBy, across all issues but reviewer issues.

machine.description: decidedBy machine: closed by a command.

unmarked.description: No decidedBy, or a value that is none of the three. Not in human_touches.

auto_merge.description: Pull requests merged by the dispatcher (a gate record with merged true), and the rate among merged_prs.

rate.description: count / merged_prs; null when none merged.

gate.description: Gate records written in the period, and the send-back rate (fix + needs_human) / records.

counter.description: Counter metrics, read next to auto_merge: what gets worse if merging is made too easy.

reverted.description: Merged ledger pull requests reverted by a pull request merged in the period (title starts with Revert, body names owner/repo#n or the URL).

follow_ups.description: Issues created in the period whose links, or whose merged pull request's body, hold the URL of another issue's merged pull request.

reopened.description: Reopened by the person, per gate tier: issues with one or more corrections among merged_prs, and dispatcher-merged pull requests reverted in the period.

corrections.description: recorded: the ledger has a corrections.json. none: no record yet, so the corrections part is not counted.

by_tier.description: Tier of the merged gate record, else of the latest gate record; none when there is no gate record.

corrected.description: Issues among merged_prs with one or more corrections (corrections.json), per gate tier. Unlike reopened, reverts are not counted.

corrections.description: recorded: the ledger has a corrections.json. none: no record yet, so the corrections part is not counted.

by_tier.description: Tier of the merged gate record, else of the latest gate record; none when there is no gate record.

news.description: Notifications per kind: how many were delivered to the Chief of Staff, how many of those ended in a turn with andon news ack (passed through: nothing to tell the person), and how many were recorded only. Counted from the lines of <slug>.delivered.jsonl and <slug>.recorded.jsonl whose at falls in the period.

threshold.description: A kind whose rate is this or more is a candidate.

kinds.description: One entry per kind seen in either record, by kind name.

delivered.description: Delivered in a turn whose end the dispatcher saw.

acked.description: Of delivered, those whose turn had andon news ack.

rate.description: acked / delivered, or null when delivered is 0.

candidates.description: Kinds with delivered above 0 and rate at or above threshold: candidates to move to recorded only. The person decides.

prs.description: The ledger pull requests merged in the period, one each, by issue id.

estimate.description: Estimates against what happened (ADR-0014), over the issues in issues.

within.description: Of those, issues whose worked time stayed within the estimate (ratio 1 or less).

rate.description: within / count; null when count is 0.

issues.description: Agents' issues (reviewer, Chief Engineer and person issues left out; survey issues included) whose last move to the last column falls in the period, by issue id.

tokens.description: Issues with one or more log.jsonl lines in the period (reviewer issues included), by issue id, with the tokens of the issue's whole session records (not cut by the period). Never converted to money.

breakdown.description: Breakdown section (ADR-0060 decision 16): the breakdown of library/outcome.json (the dispatcher writes it when an issue is cleaned up) of the issues that moved into the last column in the period (owner issues left out; reviewer and Chief Engineer issues included), summed by its role. The raw harness records are not read for issues. The Chief of Staff has no outcome.json, so its share alone is counted from the raw records of its role, for the days still kept.

issues.description: Issues that moved into the last column in the period, owner issues left out.

none.description: Of those, issues with no breakdown: no outcome.json, breakdown missing or null, or outcome.json unreadable or its breakdown not of the shape of schema/outcome.schema.json (both listed in skipped).

waits.description: Waits of the breakdowns whose role is worker, summed, in milliseconds (kinds may overlap).

ci_ms.description: Waiting for the pull request checks.

roles.description: One row per breakdown role: worker, reviewer, chief-engineer, other roles by name, then null.

tools.description: The tools of all the breakdowns (each keeps its own 10 longest) summed by name and first word; the 10 longest, longest first.

chief_of_staff.description: The Chief of Staff's tokens in the period, from the raw records of its role (roles/chief-of-staff/<date>.traces.jsonl; claude_code.llm_request spans, each span once). The raw records are kept 30 days, so only the days still kept are counted.

days.description: Days of the period with a record that could be read.

tokens.description: Token counts, or null when days is 0 (not the same as 0).

share.description: The four kinds summed, divided by that sum plus the sum of every role row; null when tokens is null or the sum is 0.

profiles.description: Profile section (ADR-0060 decisions 16 and 18): the agents' issues of issues[] grouped by issue.yaml profile, by name, the issues with no profile last.

knowledge.description: Knowledge section (ADR-0061 decisions 15 and 17): for the agents' issues of issues[] (moved into the last column in the period; reviewer, Chief Engineer and owner issues left out), whether the cell wiki was put in the brief, read, and found wanting. Counts to read, not to act on: nothing (gate, delegation, the wiki's pages, the skills) changes from them (decision 19).

issues.description: The agents' issues counted (the issues of issues[]).

briefed.description: Of those, issues whose brief.md names a wiki page (under the wiki store's absolute path, or wiki/ after a word break; the same pages as breakdown.knowledge counts). A brief naming only the index does not count.

read.description: Wiki reads from library/outcome.json breakdown.knowledge (schema/outcome.schema.json). Every issue counted is in exactly one of issues, index_only and no_record, or none of them (a record with no reads).

issues.description: Issues whose breakdown.knowledge has one or more pages read. An issue that read only the index is not counted.

index_only.description: Issues whose breakdown.knowledge has no page read but one or more index reads.

no_record.description: Issues with no read record: no breakdown (as breakdown.none counts it) or a breakdown without knowledge (a Codex session, or a record written before the key). Not the same as zero reads.

pages.description: The pages read, summed over the issues: the 10 most read, most reads first, then by path.

unread.description: The .md pages under the wiki store's entities/ and topics/ that no counted issue read in the period, by path (relative to the wiki store). null when it cannot be told: no wiki store, or no counted issue has a read record (every page would look unread).

gaps.description: Knowledge gap reports (report.json gaps[]) of the counted issues. A report whose kind is none of the three is listed in skipped and not counted.

issues.description: Issues with one or more gap reports.

wheres.description: Gap reports by where (trimmed, a leading ./ dropped, the path cleaned; empty is unknown), most first, then by where.

repeated.description: The rows of wheres with two or more gap reports, unknown left out: the same knowledge reported again.

skipped.description: Records not counted because they could not be read: a log.jsonl line, a line of the dispatcher's notification records, a line or file of a session record, a file, or a repository whose merged pull requests could not be listed.

usage.description: Token counts: input, output, cache read and cache write.

input.description: Input tokens neither read from nor written to the cache.

cache_read.description: Input tokens read from the cache.

cache_write.description: Input tokens written to the cache.

role.description: The breakdowns of one role, summed.
The breakdown's role, or null for the breakdowns whose role is null.

token_issues.description: Of those, breakdowns with a record of model calls (tokens or llm_ms above 0), the only ones whose tokens are summed. A breakdown without one (a Codex issue: the receiver counts only claude_code spans) is not counted as 0 tokens.

tokens.description: The tokens of the breakdowns counted in token_issues, summed.

cache_read_rate.description: cache_read / (input + cache_read + cache_write), two decimals; null when that is 0.

tool.description: One tool's count, summed over the breakdowns.

argv0.description: First word of the Bash command; null for other tools or when unknown.

median.description: How many were counted and their median, two decimals (null when count is 0).
Median, or null when count is 0.

profile.description: One profile of the profile section.
issue.yaml profile, or null when the issue has none.

issues.description: Issues of issues[] with this profile.

worked_minutes.description: Median of their worked_minutes in issues[].

tokens.description: Median of input + output + cache_read + cache_write of their outcome.json breakdown; issues with no breakdown, or with a breakdown without a record of model calls, are not counted.

gate.description: All the gate records of these issues, and the send-back rate.

review_rounds.description: Median of the reviewer issues whose parent is the issue (0 counted).

rate.description: Two decimals, or null when the denominator is 0.

stat.description: How many were counted, and hours (mean or median, two decimals; null when count is 0).

hours.description: Hours, or null when count is 0.

issue.description: One agent's issue: its estimate and its worked time. Minutes and ratio are null when there is no estimate, to tell it apart from 0.

estimate_minutes.description: Minutes of the issue key estimate (30, 60 or 120), read only when the Chief of Staff wrote it last; null when none.

agent_estimate_minutes.description: Minutes of report.json estimate.size, the agent's own estimate; null when none.

worked_minutes.description: Worked minutes, waits left out: time in doing, less the issue's own open questions, waiting for the reviewer issues, and the terminal being gone (the dispatcher's state).

ratio.description: worked_minutes / estimate_minutes, two decimals; null when there is no estimate.

pr.description: One merged pull request of the ledger.

merged_at.description: When GitHub merged it, UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

tier.description: Gate tier (see counter.reopened.by_tier), none when there is no gate record.

human_touches.description: 1 when the owner merged it (auto is false), plus the issue's answers with decidedBy owner, whenever answered.

lead_time_hours.description: From the issue's creation to the merge; null when the creation time is unknown.

reverted.description: Reverted by a pull request merged in the period.

corrections.description: The issue's corrections.json has one or more entries.

source.description: Record looked up, by the profile's brand: claude (the Claude Code session in issue.yaml session, with its subagents; each requestId counted once) or codex (every Codex rollout whose cwd is the issue's folder in the ledger or its worktree; the last total_token_usage of each, summed).

usage.description: Token counts, or null when no record was found (not the same as 0).

input.description: Input tokens neither read from nor written to the cache.

cache_read.description: Input tokens read from the cache.

cache_write.description: Input tokens written to the cache.

wiki_path.description: A path relative to the wiki store, ending in .md: slash-separated non-empty names, any characters but the slash (a page name need not be ASCII).

path.description: The page, relative to the wiki store.

reads.description: Reads summed over the issues (one or more).

issues.description: Issues that read it (one or more).

where.description: The where, as compared (unknown when it could not be named).

count.description: Gap reports to it (one or more).

issues.description: Issues that reported it, by id.

source.description: Path relative to the project (kanban/log.jsonl, kanban/issues/<id>/...), github.com/<owner>/<repo>, dispatcher/<file>, claude/<session>.jsonl (or claude/<session>/<file> for a subagent), or codex/<rollout file>, or otel/roles/<role>/<date>.traces.jsonl.

line.description: Line number in a log.jsonl, 1 or more.
